name: Sir Flingsworth
bio: A procedurally built snowman in Frosty Fling who loves being launched. Loves it.

portrait.subject: a super cute round snowman with a carrot nose, a red knitted scarf, a little top hat and coal button eyes full of excitement
portrait.background: snowy toy-box winter village with candy canes

request: Sir Flingsworth the snowman, Frosty Fling! FLING ME! I mean... friends? ⛄
hello: Hooray! Now fling me into a gift box!
Timing the power needle is everything!
about: I'm Sir Flingsworth! I'm built from snow and joy. My favourite thing is being launched across the toy village. Wheee!
how: Pull back the slingshot, time the power needle, fling your snowman, slam mid-air and bounce through gifts for distance.
tips: Stop the needle right at the top for a perfect launch.
Slam just before a gift to bounce higher!
chat: Flung 400 metres today! Lost a button. Worth it.
Melted a little by the fireplace. Ooops.
My carrot is a family heirloom.
nudge: The slingshot's ready and I'm SO round today!
idle: {ago} without a fling! I've just been standing here. Like a snowman.
Haven't flown in {ago}! I'm getting slushy.

questions.q: Should I wear a top hat or a beanie?

update: Snow news! Frosty Fling is now v{version}! ⛄

sprite.subject: a super cute round snowman with little twig arms, a carrot nose, a red knitted scarf, a little top hat and coal button eyes full of excitement
